set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fixtures)
function(add_fixture name mode)
  add_executable(${name} int64_add.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE FIXTURE_MODE=${mode})
  target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endfunction()
add_fixture(int64-add-correct 0)
add_fixture(int64-add-m01-arithmetic 1)
add_fixture(int64-add-m02-overflow 2)
add_fixture(int64-add-m03-invalid 3)
add_fixture(int64-add-m04-extra-text 4)
add_fixture(int64-add-m05-hang 5)
add_fixture(int64-add-m06-write 6)
add_fixture(int64-add-output-limit 7)
add_fixture(int64-add-crash 8)
